Remark
[scope of the large-time canonical-neighborhood estimate] Source: cao-zhu ↗ cor:cz-large-time-local-volume-canonical-neighborhoods 1. Remark 7.5.4\group Curvature Estimates after Surgery

In section 7.3 of \cite{P2}, Perelman claimed a stronger statement than the above Corollary 3 that allows $r_0 < \theta ^{-1}h$ in the assumptions. Nevertheless, the above weaker statement is sufficient to deduce the geometrization result.
